verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only client-side and in-request batching. The official Python SDK offers an asynchronous client, with an optional aiohttp backend for concurrency (gh-4, gh-5), and the Search API advertises multi-query search (docs-17). Tier-based rate limits that rise with spend also support higher volume (docs-16). There is no documented server-side batch endpoint or asynchronous job submission with polling or callbacks for high-volume workloads. Missing for 10: a dedicated batch/async job API with job status and retrieval, batch pricing or limits documentation, and hands-on corroboration of high-volume throughput.
